reason: Iteration 0 showed a passive 'do nothing' policy (94% Action 0) due to lack of terminal success signal and insufficient velocity control. Position shaping incentivized free-fall. This revision activates terminal success/failure signals and adds dense velocity penalty during flight to encourage controlled descent and braking.
changed_design: Activated terminal_success_reward (+100) for successful landing conditions at termination
Activated crash_penalty (-100) for non-successful terminations to break passive policy
Added velocity_magnitude_penalty during flight to discourage uncontrolled free-fall
Adjusted position shaping weights slightly relative to new velocity penalty
risk: Agent might learn to trigger leg contact immediately by crashing hard if velocity penalty is insufficient at terminal step (mitigated by success criteria requiring low velocity)
High crash penalty (-100) combined with step cost might encourage risky behavior if landing seems impossible

expected_metric_changes.fitness_score: Increase (less negative) as agent learns to land successfully

repeatable_bonus_safety_check: Terminal success reward is gated by termination flag and specific state conditions, preventing repeated collection within an episode.
